title: Pinned study
description: A suspended drawing moves within its frame and settles back into place.
useCase: Give a movable preview a clear resting position and physical resistance.
interaction: Drag the study or nudge it with arrow keys
reducedMotion: Live reduced-motion preferences remove interpolation and decorative playback. All content and native controls remain available. Keyboard changes settle immediately.
limitations: Original demonstration content; adapt labels and state to the host product.
look: Muted grey-green framed mat with one pinned cream sheet showing a fine geometric line drawing inside a thin red circle.
motion: Dragging moves the sheet at 0.65× pointer speed within a small clamp, tilting slightly with horizontal offset; release returns it to rest over 650 ms on an overshooting cubic-bezier.
adapt: Pointer handlers on the `drawing` button set `position`, clamped to ±45 by ±30 px with a `position.x * 0.06` degree tilt; `end` resets it, and the `drawing` CSS transition `cubic-bezier(.2,1.35,.3,1)` supplies the overshoot. Replace the SVG study and caption.
